prs.title: Tree names refit when the browser's text size changes
prs.head: dbec4312

parity.summary: Every tree name at the default text size, on main's build and this branch, on the USA tree with the long-name fixture at 390, 1280 and 1600px: 18 of 18 identical in fit, break, height and lines. Page weight differs; see Divergences.

Make Text Bigger (⌥⌘+)

divergences.text: **Most pages carry about 0.2 KB more JavaScript.** The browser bundle already includes the database schema on main, so the new column's definition ships to every page. The player page and some moderator pages go the other way: about 0.4 KB less and one request fewer.

**The phone search page reads slower on CI's final run.** Largest paint went 3.48 → 3.63 s, with ranges that don't overlap (noise floor 0.12 s). On the previous run the same page read 3.62 → 3.68 s, no difference. The search page's code and queries are untouched.

behavior_changes.text: When a reader changes the browser's text size, every tree name refits at once, as a fresh load at that size draws it. Main kept the old fit until the next window-width change, so a name could run past its card, start below its BR with room beside it, or break mid-word with room to spare.
behavior_changes.why: Every card is sized in rem, so a text-size change resizes them with no resize event.

evidence.label: red on main, green in 3 engines

behavior_changes.text: **docs/e2e.md lists the new `tree-text-size.spec.ts` suite,** which checks that every tree name refits as the text size changes, in all three engines. Main's suite table had no row for it.
behavior_changes.why: Listing the text-size suite helps the next agent find it before writing another.

not_asked_for.text: WebKit's root-size cases get three times the 30 s test timeout (`test.slow`).
not_asked_for.why: Measured 26–43 s in Playwright's Linux WebKit container on CI's 4 CPUs and 2 workers.

not_asked_for.text: The window-width resize listener is kept beside the new observer.
not_asked_for.why: A width change still fits before the tree's room under an open panel is measured.

not_asked_for.text: New e2e/tree-text-size.spec.ts runs in all three engines. The long-name fixture moved unchanged into e2e/support/tree-names.ts.
A Chromium-only case changes Chrome's default font size over CDP at 1500px.
not_asked_for.why: It caught a first version that compared card width only.

not_asked_for.text: The sweep runs under the wider face too, per docs/e2e.md's fit rule.
A Folder stays open through the sweep; its names and heading are checked.
The sweep takes the glass blur off before first paint, as an adopted stylesheet.
not_asked_for.why: CI's runner was shut down twice: headless Linux WebKit took 6.4 GiB on this tree against 1.4 GiB with the blur off. Names measured identical with and without blur in all three engines.

not_asked_for.text: A follow-up was filed as #620: measure the tree's glass cost on a real iPhone and a low-end Android.

rejected_or_reverted.why: A Folder's face precedes its panel, so the first `.tree-card` is never a panel card.

rejected_or_reverted.text: A ResizeObserver loop error with an open Folder when the first card is a Folder face.
rejected_or_reverted.why: Not reproduced in 3 engines across 18 root sizes with a Folder first and open.
The literals are DESIGN.md's numbers, an independent check.

attention.text: **Open, for you:** Safari's Make Text Bigger (⌥⌘+) and Firefox's Zoom Text Only can't be driven from automation. The fix assumes they resize `rem` boxes along with the text. One check by hand settles it; steps are in the PR's "How to test".
